title: Detailed magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8b5a2b'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#b5762f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6e4218'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='starG' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7a8'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f1c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shaft -->
  <polygon points='38,96 46,96 58,50 52,48' fill='url(#wand)'/>
  <polygon points='46,96 50,96 57,50 53,49' fill='#d4934a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- spiral wrapping -->
  <path d='M41,88 Q47,84 52,82' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42,78 Q48,74 53,72' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M43,68 Q49,64 54,62' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M44,58 Q50,54 55,53' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <!-- star body -->
  <polygon points='55,8 61.5,30 85,31 66.5,45 73.5,68 55,54 36.5,68 43.5,45 25,31 48.5,30'
           fill='url(#starG)' stroke='#ffe97a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- inner star highlight -->
  <polygon points='55,18 58.5,32 73,32.5 62,41.5 66,56 55,47.5 44,56 48,41.5 37,32.5 51.5,32'
           fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff7a8'>
    <polygon points='88,14 89.5,19 94,20.5 89.5,22 88,27 86.5,22 82,20.5 86.5,19'/>
    <polygon points='20,48 21.5,53 26,54.5 21.5,56 20,61 18.5,56 14,54.5 18.5,53'/>
    <polygon points='86,62 87.5,67 92,68.5 87.5,70 86,75 84.5,70 80,68.5 84.5,67'/>
    <polygon points='30,10 31,14 35,15 31,16 30,20 29,16 25,15 29,14'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffd93b' opacity='0.85'>
    <circle cx='15' cy='24' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='84' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='78' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='10' r='1.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- glow rings around star -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#ffe97a' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#fff2b0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.25'/>
</svg>
